test-code.description: If in a test method is reported
Test without conditional execution is allowed
If in an ordinary method is allowed
Nested if and else-if are reported separately
Ternary expression in an argument is reported
Try with multiple catches is reported once
Explicit throw in a test is reported
Try-with-resources is allowed but plain try-finally is reported
All loop types are allowed by default
All loop types are reported when disabled
If inside an explicitly allowed loop is still reported
JUnit 3, JUnit 4 and TestNG methods are checked
Parameterized and repeated tests are checked
Control flow inside a test lambda is reported
Methods of local and anonymous classes are ignored
Setup methods and ordinary helper methods are ignored
Direct assertions and exception assertion calls are allowed
